column1: Article  30  -  Servants,  Agents  -  Aggregation  of  Claims
1.  If  an  action  is  brought  against  a  servant  or  agent  of  the  carrier
arising  out  of  damage  to  which  the  Convention  relates,  such  servant  or
agent, if they prove that they acted within the scope of their employment,
shall  be  entitled  to  avail  themselves  of  the  conditions  and  limits  of
liability  which  the  carrier  itself  is  entitled  to  invoke  under  this
2.  The  aggregate  of  the  amounts  recoverable  from  the  carrier,  its
servants  and  agents,  in  that  case,  shall  not  exceed  the  said  limits.
3.  Save  in  respect  of  the  carriage  of  cargo,  the  provisions  of
paragraphs  1  and  2  of  this  Article  shall  not  apply  if  it  is  proved  that  the
